'''Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas''' (born February 25, 1958) is a Spanish-American academic who is a professor of mathematics at [[Tufts University]] in [[Medford, Massachusetts|Medford]], [[Massachusetts]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://asegrad.tufts.edu/faculty/montserrat-teixidor-i-bigas|title=Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas {{!}} Tufts University - Graduate Programs|website=asegrad.tufts.edu|access-date=2019-05-07}}</ref> She specializes in [[algebraic geometry]], especially [[Moduli space#Moduli of vector bundles|Moduli of Vector Bundles]] on curves.<ref>[http://math.tufts.edu/people/facultyTeixidor.htm People Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas]</ref>

== Education ==
Teixidor i Bigas was born in [[Barcelona]] in 1958. She earned a bachelor's degree and PhD from the [[University of Barcelona]], where she wrote her dissertation, "[[Geometry]] of [[linear system]]s on [[algebraic curve]]s", under the supervision of Gerard Eryk Welters.<ref>[http://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=95650 Mathematics Genealogy Project]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas|url=https://webhosting.math.tufts.edu/mteixidor/cv.html|access-date=2021-01-10|website=webhosting.math.tufts.edu}}</ref>

== Career ==
She worked in the department of [[pure mathematics]] at the [[University of Liverpool]], where she wrote "The divisor of curves with a vanishing theta-null",<ref>[http://archive.numdam.org/ARCHIVE/CM/CM_1988__66_1/CM_1988__66_1_15_0/CM_1988__66_1_15_0.pdf The divisor of curves with a vanishing theta-null]</ref> for ''[[Compositio Mathematica]]'' in 1988.

In 1997, she proved [[Lange's conjecture]] for the generic curve, with [[Barbara Russo (mathematician)|Barbara Russo]], which states that "If <math>0<s\le n'(n-n')(g-1)</math>, then there exist stable vector bundles with <math>s_{n'}(E)=s</math>." They also clarified what happens in the interval <math>n'(n-n')(g-1)<s\le n'(n-n')g</math> using a degeneration argument to a reducible curve.<ref>[http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1997alg.geom..5019T On Lange's Conjecture]</ref>

She took up an appointment as an Associate Professor of Mathematics at Tufts University, and has been on the faculty of Tufts since 1989. She has been a reviewer for several journals, including the [[Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society]], the [[Duke Mathematical Journal]], and the [[journal of algebraic geometry]]. She has held visiting positions at [[Brown University]] and the [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu/people/montserrat-teixidor-i-bigas|title=Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas|date=2012-03-16|website=Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University|language=en|access-date=2019-05-07}}</ref> She was also a co-organizer of the [[Clay Institute]]'s workgroup on Vector Bundles on Curves.<ref>[http://sites.tufts.edu/poincare/meet-the-team/montserrat-teixidor-i-bigas/ Montserrat Teixidor-i-Bigas]</ref>

In 2004, she spent a year at [[Radcliffe College]] as a [[Vera Mikol|Vera M. Schuyler]] Fellow, devoting her time to study of "the interplay between the geometry of curves and the equations defining them."<ref>[http://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu/people/montserrat-teixidor-i-bigas FELLOW Montserrat Teixidor i Bigas]</ref>
